project.name: student-attendance-system
project.displayName: ระบบเช็คชื่อนักเรียน (Student Attendance System)

appMetadata.securityRule: Store authorization claims strictly in app_metadata to prevent client tampering

tables.name: profiles
tables.description: Staff profile directory linked to Supabase Auth users

tables.name: classrooms
tables.description: Classroom definitions and advisor teacher mapping

tables.name: students
tables.description: Student master data with classroom enrollment and parent contact

tables.name: courses
tables.description: Subject courses, timetable slots, and assigned instructors

tables.name: subject_attendance_records
tables.description: Subject attendance session headers with concurrency versioning

tables.name: subject_attendance_entries
tables.description: Individual student attendance status per subject session

tables.name: homeroom_attendance_records
tables.description: Morning homeroom check session headers with concurrency versioning

tables.name: homeroom_attendance_entries
tables.description: Individual student attendance status per morning homeroom check

tables.name: system_settings
tables.description: Global school organization settings, academic cycle, and thresholds

rowLevelSecurity.strategy: Strict Role-Based Access Control via app_metadata

policies.name: Users can update their own profile
Teachers can manage attendance for their courses
Staff can view subject attendance records
Teachers and admins can manage subject attendance entries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.subject_attendance_records r WHERE r.id = record_id AND (r.recorder_id = (select auth.uid()) OR ((select auth.jwt()) -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role') = 'admin'))

policies.name: Staff can view subject attendance entries
Advisors can manage attendance for their advisory class
Advisors and admins can manage homeroom attendance entries
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.homeroom_attendance_records r WHERE r.id = record_id AND (r.recorder_id = (select auth.uid()) OR ((select auth.jwt()) -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'role') = 'admin'))

policies.name: Staff can view homeroom attendance entries

triggers.name: trg_check_concurrency_version
triggers.description: Increments version on record updates for Optimistic Concurrency Control

policies.name: Authenticated staff can view student photos
